about: Task 17's GIS importer, converter self-consistency on public models converted to GIS by our own writers (residualmap/fixtures.py), never a test on a utility's own layer (R6): ky4's mains rebuilt from four utility-style layers against the pre-registered bar (part 'rebuild'), ky4 drawn by hand in Google Earth (part 'kml', no bar), the file-format quirks, snapping invariance and chains, deterministic IDs, diameter text, clean refusals, a valve layer's status, WNTR's own GIS schema with its JSON (part 'wntr'), and the cases of the task's final verification (part 'final'). Written by python -m residualmap.intake_exp gis; the task17 checks in residualmap/checks.py rerun every part and compare.
